pages.text: 放学了，小朋友们一个一个被爸爸妈妈接走了。咘咘坐在幼儿园门口的小椅子上，等妈妈来。她有点紧张——嘴唇不知道什么时候，又被牙齿轻轻咬住了。
pages.text_en: School was over. One by one, the other kids were picked up. Bubu sat on a little chair by the kindergarten gate, waiting for Mama. She felt a little nervous — and without realizing it, her teeth were gently biting her lower lip again.

pages.text:
NOMI走过来，轻轻蹲下看着咘咘的脸：“咘咘，你的嘴唇又红红的了。”
咘咘摸了摸自己的下嘴唇：“啊？我不知道我在咬啊……”
pages.text_en:
NOMI walked over and gently knelt down to look at Bubu’s face. “Bubu, your lip is all red again.”
Bubu touched her lower lip. “Huh? I didn’t know I was biting it...”

pages.text:
回家的路上，NOMI温柔地问：“咘咘，你为什么咬嘴唇呀？”
咘咘想了想，小声说：“因为……心里有点紧紧的感觉。”
pages.text_en:
On the way home, NOMI asked gently, “Bubu, why do you bite your lip?”
Bubu thought for a moment and said quietly, “Because... my heart feels a little tight.”

pages.text:
第二天，妈妈带咘咘去看长颈鹿医生。医生弯下长长的脖子，仔细看了看咘咘的牙齿。
“你的门牙有点往前跑了哦，”医生轻轻说，“如果一直咬下去，以后可能要戴一个东西在牙齿上——叫牙套。”
pages.text_en:
The next day, Mama took Bubu to see Dr. Giraffe. The doctor bent his long neck down and carefully examined Bubu’s teeth.
“Your front teeth are moving forward a little,” he said gently. “If you keep biting, you might need to wear something on your teeth someday — it’s called braces.”

pages.text:
“牙套是什么？”咘咘睁大眼睛问。
医生拿出一个牙齿模型：“就像给牙齿穿一件小衣服，但是会有点不舒服，吃东西也不方便。”
咘咘皱起小眉头：“我不想戴……”
pages.text_en:
“What are braces?” Bubu asked with wide eyes.
The doctor held up a tooth model. “It’s like putting a little outfit on your teeth. But it can be uncomfortable, and eating gets tricky.”
Bubu frowned. “I don’t want that...”

pages.text:
医生温柔地笑了：“没关系，现在还来得及！只要慢慢不咬了，牙齿就会自己回来的。”
咘咘点点头，心里记住了。
pages.text_en:
The doctor smiled warmly. “Don’t worry, there’s still time! If you slowly stop biting, your teeth will move back on their own.”
Bubu nodded and kept that in her heart.

pages.text:
回到家，NOMI变戏法一样，从身后拿出一只粉粉的、软软的小毛绒兔子。
“咘咘，下次心里紧紧的时候，试试捏捏这个小兔兔？”
pages.text_en:
Back home, NOMI pulled out a soft, pink plush bunny from behind her back like magic.
“Bubu, next time your heart feels tight, try squeezing this little bunny instead!”

pages.text:
咘咘接过小兔兔，用力捏了捏它圆圆的肚子——“咕唧！”
好软！好舒服！
“真的有点好玩诶！”咘咘笑了。
pages.text_en:
Bubu took the bunny and squeezed its round tummy — “Squish!”
So soft! So nice!
“This is actually kind of fun!” Bubu giggled.

pages.text:
第二天在幼儿园，老师提了一个很难的问题。咘咘感觉嘴唇又想咬了……
她赶紧把手伸进口袋，摸到小兔兔，用力捏了捏。
嘴唇没有被咬到！
pages.text_en:
The next day at kindergarten, the teacher asked a really hard question. Bubu felt her lip wanting to bite again...
She quickly reached into her pocket, found the little bunny, and gave it a big squeeze.
Her lip stayed safe!

pages.text:
NONO在咘咘肩膀上悄悄竖起小翅膀：“叽叽！咘咘做到了！”
咘咘偷偷笑了，心里暖暖的。
pages.text_en:
NONO quietly raised his little wings on Bubu’s shoulder. “Cheep cheep! Bubu did it!”
Bubu smiled secretly, feeling warm inside.

pages.text:
晚上睡觉前，咘咘躺在床上，又有点想咬嘴唇。她抱紧小兔兔，轻轻捏了捏它的耳朵……
捏着捏着，就慢慢睡着了。
pages.text_en:
At bedtime, Bubu lay in bed and felt the urge to bite again. She hugged her little bunny tight and gently squeezed its ear...
Squeezing and squeezing, she slowly drifted off to sleep.

pages.text:
一个星期后，NOMI指着咘咘的嘴唇笑：“看！不红了，变回粉粉的了！”
咘咘跑到镜子前看了看，开心地笑了：“真的诶！”
pages.text_en:
A week later, NOMI pointed at Bubu’s lip and smiled. “Look! It’s not red anymore — it’s back to pink!”
Bubu ran to the mirror and looked. She grinned happily. “It really is!”

pages.text:
咘咘抱着小兔兔，对镜子里的自己说：“咘咘不咬嘴唇了。紧紧的时候，捏捏兔兔就好了。”
NOMI站在旁边，骄傲地微笑着。
pages.text_en:
Bubu held her bunny and said to her reflection, “Bubu doesn’t bite her lip anymore. When things feel tight, I just squeeze my bunny.”
NOMI stood beside her, smiling proudly.
